data: Karen
Underprivileged Position: Starting hand size -1
I'm not going to lose!
People like me never had a chance...
Things are going to change now.
Having to fight for the scraps of salvation is nothing new. Bring it!
I'm sorry everyone... Curse this rotten world.
Only one of us can be saved. I just wanted it more.
I promised the kids I'd see them again. I WILL win!
I was so close. Why me? Why did the gods brand me a sinner?
You're a fellow sinner. I wish for you to be reborn into a happier life but will not pray to the gods for that.
Luna
Extortionate Tithe: Whenever you play a card, lose $1.
Ohohoho! Time for your beating!
It can't be... It's over before I ever started...
In this world, money is everything.
I'm a self-made woman. Those others underestimated me.
I've been robbed of what's rightfully mine. Again.
This is meritocracy. This is fair... and just...
I've stepped on many to get here. You'll be one more.
Just one more step, and I could've obtained what my money couldn't buy...
Wait for me, mother, father. I'll see you soon.
Alice
Fraying Sanity: You get -0.5 mult.
You will fall before me.
How could this happen to me?
You're 100 years too early to challenge me.
I walked the realm of gods. This is nothing in comparison.
My punishment never ends.
I'm a survivor, always have been.
You've made it this far. You must be a worthy enemy.
I gave up my humanity for power, and it wasn't enough.
Finally, I shall be rid of my brand.
Ravi
Overconsumption: This character has double the usual points.
I'll clean you up before lunchtime.
My stomach doesn't feel so good...
You're just an appetizer!
My wish is to always have more.
Infinite growth was unsustainable.
Your soul will at least keep me full for a while.
Nothing tastes like the food from the farm we lost.
It's ok. I finally don't feel hungry anymore.
One step closer to having more...
Tiffany
Choking Scent: Nullify the effects of 1 randomly selected suit
Think you got what it takes to hang with me?
This is so lame.
Take the L.
The chumps till now couldn't satisfy me. Are you different?
I should've listened to my parents...
Lol, that was too quick.
Neither of us will be saved. But I want to enjoy the pleasure of living just a bit longer.
Have enough fun for the both of us.
You were tough. I just wanted it more.
Mona
Frozen Time Zone: 1 random square becomes unusuable.
What a drag.
I didn't even get started.
Whew, I didn't break a sweat.
I haven't worked this hard since college.
Why can't I ever do anything right?
You couldn't cut it. I know that feeling.
I haven't slept in days. It'll be over soon.
I can never get a break.
I'll never have to work again!
Wendy
Jealous Sabotage:1 random item you have is nullifed until end of battle.
You've got something flashy I want.
I never get what I want.
What's yours is mine.
Let's see if you're just another spoiled rich kid.
If only I could've been as blessed as you.
You didn't earn anything. I did.
You have no idea how much I've had to fight to survive.
Take what's left of me. You deserve it.
Everything will belong to me, not the parasites who inherited them.
The First Witch
Void: You get -1 mult.
I am The First Witch. Show me you are worthy of your wish.
If it's you, you may even be able to challenge the gods who cursed us.
How disappointing.
